svg.title: How a microRNA is made: Drosha and Dicer cut it from a hairpin, Argonaute keeps one strand, and its seed pairs with a site in an mRNA
svg.text: 1. In the nucleus, Drosha cuts the hairpin free
2. In the cytoplasm, Dicer cuts off the loop
4. The seed pairs with a site in an mRNA
